capabilities: Add created, modified, and optional type properties to new in-scope notes
Append nested daily date tags such as date/2026/11/03 after tracked edits
Scope tracking to selected folders with exclusions for templates
Wait for Templater template completion before processing new notes
Expose a read-only API for other plugins to build date tags
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later. README warns users to back up the vault before enabling automatic frontmatter changes. Distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later; works offline with no accounts or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian does not automatically record creation and modification timestamps or accumulate a per-day tag history in a note's frontmatter.

relations.evidence: The plugin waits for Templater's completion event when a matching folder or regex creation rule is enabled.
If Linter manages modified timestamps, enable Delegate modified to Linter and configure Linter separately.
On desktop, edits made while commands such as append, prepend, property:set, daily:append, or eval run are tracked

summary: Automation plugin that maintains created and modified frontmatter timestamps and a nested daily date-tag history in tracked Markdown notes.
